title: Best of Singapore and Thailand
alt: Marina Bay in Singapore lit up after dark with the city skyline behind
transport: Private sedan transfers with shared city tours and a speedboat crossing

expert.name: Ananya Iyer
expert.quote: Singapore first while everyone is fresh, then Thailand for the beach and the street food. Families love this order.
expert.tip: Keep the Sentosa day flexible and buy the Universal Studios ticket only if the children want the rides. The cable car pass alone is enough for the views.

summary: Eight days across Singapore and Thailand. Three nights in Singapore with a city tour and the Sentosa cable car, two on the Pattaya coast with a speedboat day at Coral Island, then two in Bangkok with a full day temple tour.
included: Included: 7 nights in 3 hotels with daily breakfast; Singapore city tour; Sentosa cable car sky pass round trip; Coral Island speedboat tour from Pattaya; full day Bangkok city tour; 13 airport, intercity and sightseeing transfers; visa assistance.
not_included: Not included: international flights; the Singapore to Bangkok flight; visa charges; travel insurance; Sentosa attraction tickets; lunches and dinners; personal expenses.

1: Arrival at Changi Airport and private sedan transfer to your Singapore hotel
Check in at the ibis Novena and keep the first day free
Optional: the Singapore Zoo and the Night Safari out at Mandai
2: Breakfast, then shared transfer for the Singapore city tour
Merlion Park, Marina Bay, the Helix bridge and Chinatown
Past Raffles Hotel, the Esplanade and the civic district
Afternoon free around Orchard Road and the malls
3: Breakfast, then shared transfer across to Sentosa island
Round trip cable car sky pass with views over the harbour
Optional: Universal Studios, the SEA Aquarium or Adventure Cove
Return shared transfer to your hotel in the evening
4: Breakfast, check out and private transfer to Changi Airport
Optional: flight from Singapore to Bangkok, booked separately and not included
Private sedan transfer from Suvarnabhumi Airport down to Pattaya
Optional: the Sanctuary of Truth, Nong Nooch gardens or the floating market
5: Breakfast, then shared transfer to the Bali Hai pier
Speedboat transfer across to Coral Island for the day
Swim and sunbathe at Tawaen beach, water sports payable on the sand
Return speedboat and shared transfer to your Pattaya hotel
6: Breakfast, check out and private sedan transfer up to Bangkok
Check in and take the afternoon at your own pace
Optional: the Erawan Museum, Sea Life Bangkok or Art in Paradise
7: Breakfast, then shared transfer for the full day city tour
The Golden Buddha at Wat Traimit and Wat Maha Phruettharam
A stop at the gem gallery before the ride back to the hotel
Evening free for the markets near your hotel
8: Breakfast and an easy check out
Private sedan transfer to Suvarnabhumi Airport for your trip home

stops.name: Singapore
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast included · Deluxe room · 3★ · ibis Novena, two minutes from Novena MRT station

program.name: Marina Bay and Sentosa
program.description: Three nights in the city with a tour of Marina Bay and Chinatown, and a Sentosa day built around the cable car.

activities.name: Singapore City Tour
activities.description: A shared coach tour past Merlion Park, Marina Bay, the Helix bridge, Chinatown, Raffles Hotel and the civic district.

activities.name: Sentosa Cable Car Sky Pass
activities.description: A round trip on the cable car between Mount Faber, HarbourFront and Sentosa, with the whole harbour below you.

activities.name: Singapore Zoo
activities.description: An open enclosure zoo at Mandai with orangutans overhead and white tigers, best in the cooler morning hours.

activities.name: Night Safari
activities.description: A tram ride through the park after dark, when the lions, hyenas and leopards are actually awake.

stops.name: Pattaya
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast included · Deluxe room · 3★ · Bella Villa Prima, a short ride from the Pattaya beach road

program.name: Coral Island and easy evenings
program.description: Two nights on the Gulf coast with a speedboat day at Koh Larn and the Pattaya markets close by.

activities.name: Coral Island by Speedboat
activities.description: A speedboat day out to Koh Larn with clear water at Tawaen beach, loungers on the sand and water sports if you want them.

activities.name: Sanctuary of Truth
activities.description: An enormous carved teak temple on the shore at Naklua, still being built by hand after forty years.

activities.name: Nong Nooch Tropical Garden
activities.description: Formal gardens, a cycad collection and cultural shows on a huge estate south of the city.

stops.name: Bangkok
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast included · Deluxe room · 3★ · Convenient Park, close to the airport road and local markets

program.name: Temples, gems and city streets
program.description: Two nights in the capital with a full day tour of the Golden Buddha and the old temple quarter, and a free afternoon for markets.

activities.name: Full Day Bangkok City Tour
activities.description: A shared coach tour taking in the Golden Buddha at Wat Traimit, Wat Maha Phruettharam and a gem gallery.

activities.name: Erawan Museum
activities.description: A three headed elephant in bronze above a hall of stained glass and gardens, out towards Samut Prakan.

activities.name: Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World
activities.description: A large aquarium under Siam Paragon with a walkthrough tunnel, easy to combine with the shopping on Rama I.
